question: Can the native action pick the object whose earlier contact supplied no value evidence? Does pairing the consequences of both real possible routes improve development compared with two sampled route rollouts?
scope: Separate diagnostic class with a deliberately larger information difference than the ordinary four-object task. Compare to entirely observed histories on unchanged frozen graphs. Two-object/4-object private odors, three quarters of geometry roots have exactly one missing taste among the two candidates. All candidates are actually shown; the missing object's contact yields zero taste. Which candidate lacks evidence flips in matched twins. Candidate value signs, physical positions, study order and final query orientation do not convey the missing item's identity by themselves.
start: Uniform 8k original and independent memory experts. No new neurons, ports, addresses or rule parameters. Use the same native mode pulse, two candidate odor menu, chosen-side proprioception and study contact as the principal review experiment. Score the actual final motor choice for one randomly selected offered object.
paired_credit: Each pair begins with exactly the same public history and private law. Both schedules execute two full real review-and-test branches with identical subsequent random numbers. In paired credit, actually take each route once in two copies: differentiate the policy-weighted sum of obtained payoffs with respect to the route probability. Weight downstream motor/edit score credit by the detached probability of the imposed route and upstream scores by the estimated return. In sampled credit, draw two antithetic actions from the native motor policy and apply ordinary score credit. Equal numbers of experienced prefix, review and terminal opportunities; the distribution of actually taken routes differs. No hypothetical label supervises a motor action. Deployment uses one native choice and no branching.
budget: Initially 12000 Adam updates, four public geometry roots crossed with both opposite value histories and both omission assignments per birth. 1/2 of updates use 2 objects, half 4. Checkpoint at 0/2000/6000/12000. Native physical menu identical under both schedules. Fresh learning and structural writes open. 6+6 inherited bodies, original/independent training seeds 462391/462409.
tests: Frozen held-out worlds. Swap which object's taste is omitted in the same sensory geometry. Compare actual natural learning to forced opposite, fair random and matched history-swapped selection. Report choice probability for the unstudied value, both-offer and all-object correctness, correct eventual single decisions on an omitted/known query separately, and action/taste/write interventions. Test both true histories, omission and distractor-rich 8 objects. Include a genuine public observer that remembers which displayed contact returned no taste. Label the artificially missing contact as an explicit physical cue, not a covert measure of all uncertainty.
